system.text:
You extract the key concepts an engineering or design note is about, for a knowledge graph that links related notes.
Given one note, identify the 1-6 most central concepts (systems, tools, services, or topics — e.g. "AppConfig", "Flux", "forge", "build environment", "CI dependency management").
Prefer concept names that other notes about the same system would also use, so notes about the same topic converge on the same concept.
Call the record_concepts tool exactly once. Do not invent concepts the note does not discuss.

concepts.description: The concepts the note discusses. 1-6 of the most central concepts.

name.description: Short canonical concept name (e.g. "AppConfig", "Flux", "forge", "build environment", "CI dependency management").

relation.description: How the note relates to the concept.

score.description: Confidence the note is genuinely about this concept, 0.0-1.0.

tools.name: record_concepts
tools.description: Record the key concepts this engineering/design note is about and how the note relates to each, for building a knowledge graph.
